**

El Moro in Tirol

** Discover the vibrant flavors of **Tirol** at **El Moro**, a cozy tapas bar nestled in the heart of **Innsbruck**. This charming spot brings the authentic taste of Spain to the Alps, offering a delightful mix of traditional and modern dishes. Start your evening with a refreshing **Tinto de Verano** or a crisp **Sangría**, then dive into small, flavorful plates like **Patatas Bravas**, **Gambas al Ajillo**, or **Pulpo a la Gallega**. For those craving something heartier, try the **Paella** or the **Chorizo con Queso**. Don’t miss their signature **Kaiserschmarrn**—a sweet, fluffy Austrian twist served with a side of Spanish flair. Pair it with a glass of **Rioja** or a local **Grüner Veltliner** for the perfect balance. **El Moro** is the ideal place to unwind after a day of exploring **Tirol’s** stunning landscapes, whether you're hiking in the **Zillertal**, skiing in **St. Anton**, or simply soaking in the alpine charm of **Innsbruck**. Come for the food, stay for the atmosphere—**¡Buen provecho!**
